note.windows: Point it at your MechCommander 2 CD, or the folder holding its disc image (.iso, or a .zip of one). The first build can take one to four hours, about 6 GB of disk and 16 GB of memory: MechCommander 2 is 2.5 MB of machine code, 5.5 million lines of C. Python, CMake, Ninja and the Visual Studio Build Tools (about 3 GB) are installed if they are missing; Windows asks for permission.
note.default: MechCommander 2 builds on Windows only: the recompiled game runs on the real Windows DirectX DLLs. Use the Windows installer.
